saints.name: Peter Nolasco
saints.summary: Peter Nolasco was a Spanish saint and the founder of the Order of Our Lady of Ransom, established to redeem Christian captives from Muslim captivity. He dedicated his life to charitable works and took a vow of chastity, committing his wealth to the Church. His efforts were recognized by King James I of Aragon, and he is remembered for his deep faith and commitment to the liberation of the oppressed.
